name_reason: Current name's 'state_handle' is misleading: this is not a handle to a state struct and holds no state. It is a pointer to the dialog/menu box sprite sheet (FDOTHER.DAT resource index 2), a direct sibling of data_fd2_ui_anim_sprite_sheet_ptr in the same main load block. The buffer begins with an int32 offset table and readers resolve a sprite as base + *(int32*)(base + index*stride): stride 4 for the 4-corner settings-panel blit (fd2_open/close_settings_dialog_with_slide), stride 0xC (3 ints/entry) for the 2 Yes/No box corners (page-advance / typewriter dialog). The name should reflect the data type (sprite sheet pointer). Proposed data_fd2_menu_dialog_box_sprite_sheet_ptr keeps the correct domain (menu/dialog box) and adds the sprite-sheet pointer descriptor. No address residue in current name; 'menu_dialog' is a domain descriptor not an ID. Rename recorded only; apply in Stage 2 (touches globals.h + 6 reader call sites in dialog.c/menucfg.c/main.c).
purpose: Base pointer of the dialog/menu box sprite sheet (FDOTHER.DAT resource index 2); supplies the corner and border sprites for menu/dialog box rendering.
logic_summary: uint32 BSS pointer slot at 0x53A89, zero-initialized. Written exactly once by main @ 0x25BF4 via fd2_load_dat_resource(FDOTHER.DAT, <prior value>, 2) (prior value passed so loader frees-then-reloads). The loaded buffer's head is an int32 offset table; a sprite's pixel data is located at base + *(int32*)(base + index * stride). Readers: fd2_open_settings_dialog_with_slide (0x17513) and fd2_close_settings_dialog_with_slide (0x1775B) index 4 panel corners with stride 4 (sprite_id = arr_a[c]*3 + arr_b[c]*2); fd2_animate_dialog_page_advance_collapse (0x198A9) and fd2_text_dialog_typewriter_loop (0x19A9C, 2 read sites) index 2 Yes/No box corners with stride 0xC (3 ints per entry). Result is passed to fd2_blit_sprite_with_stride_setup.
datatype: uint32 (pointer to sprite-sheet buffer; the buffer head is an int32 offset table, payload is packed sprite pixel data)
element_semantics: Single 4-byte pointer slot holding the runtime address of the dialog/menu box sprite sheet. The pointed-to buffer: leading int32[] = byte offsets (relative to buffer base) of each sprite; trailing region = sprite pixel data for the dialog/menu box corners and borders.
comment_original_issue: Original src comment called it 'base pointer of the menu/dialog state resource' -- 'state resource' is inaccurate; the resource is a sprite sheet (offset-table-indexed sprite atlas) for dialog/menu box corner/border sprites, not a state struct.
notes: Sibling resource-pointer table at 0x53A4D..0x53AD5 (each a uint32 resource buffer pointer loaded by fd2_load_dat_resource in main). Datatype/dimension of the global itself unchanged this stage (uint32 slot). Rename touches: src/include/globals.h:372, src/life/main.c (def + writer), src/dialog/dialog.c (2 readers), src/ui_menu/menucfg.c (3 readers). Ghidra data plate was empty; created concise plate consistent with refined src comment.
